biography.plain_text: Doug Von Allmen is an American private equity investor based in Fort Lauderdale. Trained as an accountant at the University of Kentucky, he moved from corporate finance into buying businesses for himself and partners. He assembled Beauty Alliance from regional distributors and sold the professional beauty supplies group to L'Oréal.

long_biography.plain_text:
Doug Von Allmen expanded Sunsations Sunglass Company from 70 stores to 350 before selling it five years after his purchase. The chain became part of Sunglass Hut International. This was one of more than 50 businesses he acquired during a career built around buying and developing privately held companies.

His support for the University of Kentucky linked accounting education with the commercial development of research. A gift made with his wife, Linda, supported the accountancy school and an entrepreneurship centre. The donation also secured state matching funds for the Lexington Innovation and Commercialization Center, helping researchers turn ideas into businesses.
